steps.instruction: Premix a pile for each major mass before touching the canvas: shadow, half-tone, and light for every big form. Use the app to target each pile from your reference spots.
Match value to your underpainting first, hue second. A block-in that keeps the value structure can be wrong in color and still recover; the reverse cannot.
Work dark to light, background to foreground. Cover everything — no bare underpainting left — at even, modest thickness.
Keep edges soft everywhere. A block-in with hard edges is a coloring book; you will sharpen the few that matter at the end.
Step back three meters. If the masses do not read as the subject at that distance, fix it now — nothing later in the process can save a wrong block-in.
